name: top_plane_minus_100
why: IT IS THE CASE THAT LOOKS RIGHT. The add-in passes the ABSOLUTE value and adds `OptionFlip` when the distance is negative: it is the most literal reading of the enum, but there are macros going around that pass the sign directly. With those, the plane at -100 ends up at +100 and NO ERROR SAYS SO -- only this number does.

expect.tolerance_why: the origin of the plane is read from a matrix in metres
